title: A direct incentive-margin audit gives sharper credible-learning guarantees
checked_scope: The two-stream off-path monitoring audit, replacing separate confidence intervals by direct concentration of the automaton incentive margin and optimizing audit allocation.
significance: A tighter finite-sample safe-forgiveness rule and exact 2:1 cooperative/deviation sampling ratio improve the audit design while retaining equilibrium credibility.
